# TextTool

The TextTool behavior is present on 3DText objects i.e those created with the [text tool](https://kb.tabletopsimulator.com/game-tools/text-tool/).

## Functions

######

######

######

######

######

######

| Function Name | Return | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| getFontColor()getFontColor() | *returns color* | Returns Table of font Color. |
| getFontSize()getFontSize() | *returns int* | Returns Int of the font size. |
| getValue()getValue() | *returns string* | Returns the current text. Behaves the same as Object's [getValue()](object.md#getvalue). |
| setFontColor(setFontColor(...)*color* font_color) | *returns bool* | Sets font Color. |
| setFontSize(setFontSize(...)*int* font_size) | *returns bool* | Sets font size. |
| setValue(setValue(...)*string* text) | *returns bool* | Sets the current text. Behaves the same as Object's [setValue(...)](object.md#setvalue). |
